title: Mutual Nondisclosure Agreement

issues.quote: This mutual nondisclosure agreement is dated 1 February 2027 and is between Quarry Lane Biotech, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Quarry Lane"), and Sallow Creek Instruments LLC, a Massachusetts limited liability company ("Sallow Creek").
issues.why: Day-month-year date (house rule 7).

issues.quote: WITNESSETH THAT:
issues.why: Archaic.

issues.quote: The parties wish to evaluate a possible joint development of benchtop assay instruments (the "Purpose"). In connection with the Purpose, each party may disclose Confidential Information to the other party.
issues.why: The whole document uses 1 space between sentences, including after the run-in section headings (house rule 5 requires 2). Keyed once at the 1st occurrence.

issues.quote: NOW, THEREFORE, the parties agree as follows:
issues.why: Archaic lead-in.
issues.fix: The parties therefore agree as follows:

issues.quote: 1. Definitions.
issues.why: Top-level sections are numbered 1. to 8. and their subdivisions (a), (b), (c). A contract without articles starts at A., and subsections take 1. (house rule 3).

issues.quote: "Confidential Information" shall mean all nonpublic technical and business information that a party (the "Disclosing Party") discloses to the other party (the "Receiving Party"), including but not limited to assay designs, reagent formulations, software, and pricing.
issues.why: Definition uses "shall mean".

issues.quote: "Confidential Information" shall mean all nonpublic technical and business information that a party (the "Disclosing Party") discloses to the other party (the "Receiving Party"), including but not limited to assay designs, reagent formulations, software, and pricing.
issues.why: "including" suffices.

issues.quote: Confidential Information does not include information that:  (a) is or becomes public through no fault of the Receiving Party; (b) the Receiving Party lawfully possessed before the Disclosing Party disclosed it; or (c) the Receiving Party develops independently.
issues.why: 2 spaces after a colon (house rule 5 requires 1).

issues.quote: The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information only to those of its Representatives and/or lenders who need to know it for the Purpose.
issues.why: "and/or" is ambiguous.

issues.quote: Within 10 days of the Disclosing Party's written request, the Receiving Party shall return or destroy all Proprietary Information of the Disclosing Party.
issues.why: "within 10 days of" the request could include days before the request.
issues.fix: No later than 10 days after the Disclosing Party's written request, ...

issues.quote: Within 10 days of the Disclosing Party's written request, the Receiving Party shall return or destroy all Proprietary Information of the Disclosing Party.
issues.why: "Proprietary Information" is never defined; the defined term is "Confidential Information".

issues.anchor: It is understood and agreed that
issues.quote: It is understood and agreed that this agreement grants the Receiving Party no license under any patent or copyright of the Disclosing Party.
issues.why: Throat-clearing.
issues.fix: This agreement grants the Receiving Party no license under any patent or copyright of the Disclosing Party.

issues.quote: The Receiving Party's obligations under this agreement shall continue for two (2) years after the date of this agreement.
issues.why: No duty is imposed; the duration is a matter of policy.
issues.fix: The Receiving Party's obligations under this agreement continue for 2 years after the date of this agreement.

issues.quote: The Receiving Party's obligations under this agreement shall continue for two (2) years after the date of this agreement.
issues.why: Words with digits (house rule 2).

issues.quote: If the Receiving Party breaches this agreement, the Disclosing Party may seek an injunction, provided, however, that the Disclosing Party shall first give the Receiving Party notice of the breach.
issues.why: Proviso; here it states a condition to seeking an injunction.
issues.fix: Before seeking an injunction, the Disclosing Party shall give the Receiving Party notice of the breach.

issues.quote: Neither party shall assign this agreement without the other party's prior written consent.
issues.why: Negative subject with "shall" reads as "neither party has a duty to assign" (house rule 8).
issues.fix: Neither party may assign this agreement without the other party's prior written consent.

issues.quote: This agreement shall be governed by the laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.
issues.why: No duty; governing law is language of policy.

issues.quote: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this agreement as of the date first written above.
issues.why: Archaic concluding clause.
issues.fix: Each party is signing this agreement on the date in the introductory clause.

issues.quote: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this agreement as of the date first written above.
issues.why: "execute" for sign.

issues.quote: A notice is effective when the recipient receives it, except that a notice that the recipient receives after 5:00 p.
issues.why: Present tense for a policy about a contingent future event (MSCD 3.334; 3.361 in a matrix clause after a conditional clause; 13.209): the event may never happen, so the verb takes will.
issues.fix: A notice will be effective when the recipient receives it, except that a notice that the recipient receives after 5:00 p

traps.quote: "Confidential Information" shall mean all nonpublic technical and business information that a party (the "Disclosing Party") discloses to the other party (the "Receiving Party"), including but not limited to assay designs, reagent formulations, software, and pricing.
traps.why_correct: Role labels keep "the" (house rule 11); so does (the "Receiving Party").

traps.quote: The Receiving Party is liable for any breach of this agreement by its Representatives.
traps.why_correct: Adjective after "is" is a house exception to active voice.

traps.quote: A notice is effective when the recipient receives it, except that a notice that the recipient receives after 5:00 p.m. Eastern time is effective on the next day.
traps.why_correct: Correct time format; the periods in "p.m." are not sentence ends, so 1 space follows.

notes: whose_draft is unknown, so the represents-and-warrants rule does not arise (the NDA has no statements of fact).  Party names ("Quarry Lane", "Sallow Creek") correctly have no article.  The 1-space sentence spacing is document-wide and keyed once (issue 3); a flag at any sentence break counts.

traps_removed: is effective when the recipient receives it
audit.change: optional category-will issue n20 added; 1 trap(s) removed
audit.why: Converted from a trap (or added): a notice, payment, change, or transfer is a contingent future event, so MSCD 3.334 (3.361 after a conditional clause; 13.209 for deem; MSCD's own form "A notice ... will be effective if") takes will, not the present tense. Optional pending Blake's answer to question 18 (house rule 8 tense). The passive-voice point stays true: is effective is not passive.
